column1: # Hand-maintained shorthand for equipment names, on top of the generated equipment-aliases.tsv:
# shorthand<TAB>MegaMek display name. Loaded into the slang tables after each import
# (services/SlangLoader); a line here also settles a key listed in ambiguous_slang. Several lines for
# one term link every item they name; the importer names a unit file's item after the first.
# keys MegaMek gives to more than one item (2026-10-30): the unit type sorts out which one a unit has
